bank.text: On 30 May 2023, the Council voted 15 in favour on United States draft S/2023/378 and adopted it unanimously as resolution 2682 (2023). No national explanation of vote appears in this meeting record. The Council extended the existing UN Assistance Mission for Iraq (UNAMI) mandate until 31 May 2024. The Secretary-General was requested to report to the Council on fulfilment of UNAMI responsibilities every four months.

SUPPORT.text: On 30 May 2023, the Council voted 15 in favour on United States draft S/2023/378 and adopted it unanimously as resolution 2682 (2023). No national explanation of vote appears in this meeting record. The Council extended the existing UN Assistance Mission for Iraq (UNAMI) mandate until 31 May 2024. The Secretary-General was requested to report to the Council on fulfilment of UNAMI responsibilities every four months. At the Iraqi Government's request, the Special Representative and UNAMI were to prioritize advice, support and assistance on inclusive political dialogue and reconciliation, with full, equal and meaningful participation of women, and consideration of civil society and youth input.

CONSULT.text: On 30 May 2023, the Council voted 15 in favour on United States draft S/2023/378 and adopted it unanimously as resolution 2682 (2023). No national explanation of vote appears in this meeting record. The Council extended the existing UN Assistance Mission for Iraq (UNAMI) mandate until 31 May 2024. The Secretary-General was requested to report to the Council on fulfilment of UNAMI responsibilities every four months. The review was to consult Iraq, UN agencies, Member States, regional organizations, independent experts, civil society and Kuwait. Iraq's Government had expressed support for the independent review in a letter dated 18 May 2023.

The review was to assess current threats and the relevance of UNAMI's tasks, make recommendations on mandate, structure and staffing, and assess ways to support Iraq in strengthening regional cooperation.

bank.text: On 31 August 2023 in meeting S/PV.9409, the Council voted on draft S/2023/641 submitted by France. It was adopted as resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes in favour and none against, with China and the Russian Federation abstaining. Brazil voted in favour.

brazil.text: On 31 August 2023 in meeting S/PV.9409, the Council voted on draft S/2023/641 submitted by France. It was adopted as resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes in favour and none against, with China and the Russian Federation abstaining. Brazil voted in favour. Brazil supported UNIFIL's continuing work. It judged that the French text kept the mandate robust and allowed UNIFIL to operate freely, while addressing some of Lebanon's concerns.

china.text: On 31 August 2023 in meeting S/PV.9409, the Council voted on draft S/2023/641 submitted by France. It was adopted as resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes in favour and none against, with China and the Russian Federation abstaining. Brazil voted in favour. China supported UNIFIL's work but said the text did not fully address Lebanon's concerns. It stressed host-State sovereignty and consent in peacekeeping and supported closer communication between UNIFIL and Lebanon's Government and military.

russia.text: On 31 August 2023 in meeting S/PV.9409, the Council voted on draft S/2023/641 submitted by France. It was adopted as resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes in favour and none against, with China and the Russian Federation abstaining. Brazil voted in favour. Russia attributed its abstention to contentious late drafting changes and said the final text lost a prior compromise. It continued to support the mission's activities and called for coordination with Lebanon's Government.

operative.text: On 31 August 2023 in meeting S/PV.9409, the Council voted on draft S/2023/641 submitted by France. It was adopted as resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes in favour and none against, with China and the Russian Federation abstaining. Brazil voted in favour. Operative paragraph 1 extended UNIFIL's existing mandate until 31 August 2024. Paragraph 15 reaffirmed its independence in carrying out mandated tasks without prior permission and its continued coordination with Lebanon's Government under the status-of-forces agreement.

brazil,china.text: On 31 August 2023 in meeting S/PV.9409, the Council voted on draft S/2023/641 submitted by France. It was adopted as resolution 2695 (2023) by 13 votes in favour and none against, with China and the Russian Federation abstaining. Brazil voted in favour. Brazil supported UNIFIL's continuing work. It judged that the French text kept the mandate robust and allowed UNIFIL to operate freely, while addressing some of Lebanon's concerns. China supported UNIFIL's work but said the text did not fully address Lebanon's concerns. It stressed host-State sovereignty and consent in peacekeeping and supported closer communication between UNIFIL and Lebanon's Government and military. Brazil and China both supported the mission. They differed on how adequately the text addressed Lebanon's concerns.
